## Call for abstracts and papers {#current-status}

::: {.callout-important}
Abstracts for the Paper Development Workshop and Expert Workshop are due by **14 August 2026**. The online submission form will be linked here once confirmed. Applicants will be notified around **31 August 2026**.
:::

The Japan QCA Conference brings together researchers who apply QCA in empirical research and experts working on the latest QCA and related methodological developments. The conference will be held in person at Waseda University in Tokyo.

## Two workshop formats

::: {.link-grid}
::: {.link-card}
### Paper Development Workshop

Small roundtable sessions give researchers detailed, constructive feedback from QCA experts and space to discuss the methodological aspects of developing papers.

[PDW submission requirements](registration.qmd#paper-development-workshop)
:::

::: {.link-card}
### Expert Workshop

A discussion forum for experienced QCA researchers to present, develop, and debate methodological issues in QCA and related methods.

[EW submission requirements](registration.qmd#expert-workshop)
:::
:::

## Programme highlights

- Plenary keynote speeches by **Carsten Schneider** and **Peer Fiss**
- An expert roundtable on the progress of QCA practices
- Panel sessions on the latest methodological developments in QCA
- Intensive Paper Development Workshop roundtables
- An open-discussion Expert Workshop

[View the provisional programme overview](program.qmd)

## Practical information

There is **no conference fee**. PhD students accepted to the Paper Development Workshop who have no or insufficient travel funding may apply for a travel grant expected not to exceed **¥50,000**. Application details are TBA.

Questions may be sent to [jqca2026@gmail.com](mailto:jqca2026@gmail.com).
